nd5125680c7.headline: Barclay family's Very Group appoint former chancellor Nadhim Zahawi as chairman
nd5125680c7.summary: The Barclay family's Very Group has appointed former chancellor Nadhim Zahawi as chairman, replacing interim chairman Aidan Barclay.
nd5125680c7.why: Very Group is a UK online retailer within the Barclay family's business empire, and leadership changes can signal shifts in strategy.

n02f2ee5a50.headline: Fairfax Announces Purchase of 275,000 Subordinate Voting Shares for Cancellation From Chairman and CEO, Prem Watsa
n02f2ee5a50.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings repurchased 275,000 subordinate voting shares for cancellation from its chairman and CEO, Prem Watsa, announced in Toronto on May 13, 2024.
n02f2ee5a50.why: Fairfax is a Toronto-based insurance and investment holding company, and share repurchases reduce its outstanding share count.

n34530fdef0.headline: Offshore investors sell South African stocks, buy bonds
n34530fdef0.summary: Offshore investors sold a net 4.61 billion rand of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed. Bond settlement data showed foreign investors bought bonds.
n34530fdef0.why: Foreign portfolio flows into and out of South African equities and government bonds influence the rand and local market liquidity.

nf6bda716f9.headline: CPI meets $60K BTC price battle — 5 things to know in Bitcoin this week
nf6bda716f9.summary: Bitcoin is squaring up to key price support near $60,000 as another week of US consumer price index data begins.
nf6bda716f9.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price often reacts to US inflation data that shapes expectations for interest rates.

nd4c9125556.headline: Sanlorenzo, profit up double digits; backlog over 1 billion
nd4c9125556.summary: Sanlorenzo closed the first quarter with a group profit of EUR19.7 million, up 14% from EUR17.2 million a year earlier. The shipbuilder's order backlog is over EUR1 billion.
nd4c9125556.why: Sanlorenzo is an Italian builder of luxury yachts, and its order backlog indicates demand from high-net-worth buyers.

n2ba485d593.headline: Infinium joins forces with new partner for Norway’s first large-scale e-fuels plant
n2ba485d593.summary: E-fuels manufacturer Infinium will work with SMA Mineral to advance production at what will be Norway's first commercial-scale e-fuels plant. The project is at an early stage according to the input.
n2ba485d593.why: E-fuels are synthetic fuels made from hydrogen and captured carbon, and large plants are part of the shift toward lower-carbon fuels for transport and industry.

n9b5321e99f.headline: SoftBank to get more aggressive on AI after profit and asset sales
n9b5321e99f.summary: SoftBank earned a better-than-expected net income in the March quarter, helped by investment gains. The company plans to become more aggressive on artificial intelligence after profit and asset sales.
n9b5321e99f.why: SoftBank Group is a large Japanese technology investor with major stakes in AI and tech companies, so its results and strategy shift affect that sector.

n92c23d1388.headline: Philippines begins Peso-backed stablecoin sandbox testing
n92c23d1388.summary: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas has approved a test run for a peso-backed stablecoin. The central bank said the aim is to improve financial inclusion.
n92c23d1388.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank, and its regulatory sandbox decisions set the rules for how stablecoins can operate in the country.

n03a9bc6bae.headline: Blockdaemon gets greenlight for UAE expansion in Abu Dhabi
n03a9bc6bae.summary: Blockdaemon is expanding in the UAE with a new office and entity under Abu Dhabi Global Market, offering Web3 solutions for institutional blockchain adoption.
n03a9bc6bae.why: Blockdaemon is a blockchain infrastructure provider serving institutions, and its regulated entry into the UAE reflects growing institutional crypto activity.

ndd239fff39.headline: Japan's SoftBank swings to quarterly profit, eyes on Arm unit | Company Business News
ndd239fff39.summary: SoftBank booked a profit of 328.9 billion yen in January-March, versus a loss a year earlier. The second straight quarterly profit was not enough to return the full year to profit.
ndd239fff39.why: SoftBank Group is a Japanese conglomerate whose results are heavily driven by its technology investments and its stake in chip designer Arm.

n5d511f8f6c.headline: PA to pay public employees half salaries due to Israel withholding tax revenues
n5d511f8f6c.summary: The Palestinian Authority said it can pay public employees only 50% of March salaries because Israel withheld a transfer of tax revenues.
n5d511f8f6c.why: Israel collects customs and tax revenues on the Palestinian Authority's behalf, so withheld transfers directly determine the authority's ability to fund public payrolls.

n313f51feed.headline: NLC, TUC storm Ikeja, Ibadan DisCos over electricity tariff hike |
n313f51feed.summary: Workers from the NLC and TUC shut down offices of the Ikeja and Ibadan electricity distribution companies over a tariff hike, preventing staff from working.
n313f51feed.why: Nigerian electricity distribution companies buy power and sell it to consumers at regulated tariffs, so tariff changes directly affect utility revenue and household costs.

n4804a6ec21.headline: Japanese-listed firm adds Bitcoin as reserve asset with 117 BTC
n4804a6ec21.summary: Metaplanet, a publicly traded Japanese company, added Bitcoin as a reserve asset after buying 117.7 BTC, about $7.2 million.
n4804a6ec21.why: Listed companies that hold bitcoin on their balance sheets have share prices partly linked to crypto price moves.

nceb42dce39.headline: TSX moves higher on consumer staples boost
nceb42dce39.summary: Canada's main stock index moved higher on Monday, led by consumer staples stocks. Investors were awaiting key economic data later in the week.
nceb42dce39.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and its sector mix reflects the country's banks, energy and resource companies.

ncc577e57d8.headline: DeFi Technologies Subsidiary Valour Inc. Launches Internet Computer (ICP) and Toncoin (TON) ETPs, Landmark Offerings in the Nordics Alongside Chainlink (LINK) ETP
ncc577e57d8.summary: DeFi Technologies' subsidiary Valour Inc. launched Internet Computer (ICP) and Toncoin (TON) exchange-traded products, alongside a Chainlink (LINK) product, in the Nordic markets.
ncc577e57d8.why: Exchange-traded products give investors regulated access to crypto assets through traditional brokerage accounts.

n6905444739.headline: USD/CAD Outlook: Bearish Pressure Amid Canada’s Jobs Surge
n6905444739.summary: The USD/CAD pair dropped after an unexpected surge in Canada's employment numbers on Friday, leaning bearish for the pair.
n6905444739.why: USD/CAD measures how many Canadian dollars one US dollar buys, and it is driven by relative economic data and interest-rate expectations.
n6905444739.why_moved: An unexpected surge in Canada's employment numbers strengthened the Canadian dollar against the US dollar.

n7b91c9fc01.headline: Stocks grind towards record highs in inflation-heavy week
n7b91c9fc01.summary: Global stocks neared record highs in an inflation-heavy week. US CPI data is set to test bets on a September Fed rate cut, with Fed Chair Powell leading several speakers.
n7b91c9fc01.why: Equity markets are sensitive to US inflation data and Federal Reserve rate expectations, which set the cost of capital worldwide.
n7b91c9fc01.why_moved: Global stocks neared record highs while investors awaited US CPI data that could test bets on a September Fed rate cut.

n12f89a64c5.headline: Former Chancellor Nadhim Zahawi to chair Very Group
n12f89a64c5.summary: Nadhim Zahawi has been appointed chairman of the Very Group, which owns the Very and Littlewoods brands. The appointment was reported by This is Money.
n12f89a64c5.why: The Very Group is a UK online retailer whose board appointments reflect its strategy and governance under its owners.

ne905189678.headline: Tax compliance management in the digital economy
ne905189678.summary: Vietnam's General Department of Taxation held a seminar to explore effective tax compliance solutions supporting socio-economic development and state revenue in the digital era.
ne905189678.why: Tax compliance in digital economies is critical for government revenue and economic modernization, impacting business regulation and fiscal policy.

nad62459440.summary: The IMF has approved Argentina's next loan installment, praising government austerity policies that exceed previous loan conditions.
nad62459440.why: IMF funding supports Argentina's economic stabilization efforts, influencing fiscal policy and investor confidence in the country.

n1ba3551e2a.headline: Pakistan, IMF mission begin discussions on further engagement
n1ba3551e2a.summary: Pakistan's government and IMF mission started discussions on further economic engagement.
n1ba3551e2a.why: IMF talks can lead to financial aid or policy adjustments, affecting Pakistan’s economic stability.

nccd5e9c4ea.summary: Car sales in Pakistan increased significantly in April, reflecting rebounding demand following signs of economic recovery.
nccd5e9c4ea.why: Automotive companies and suppliers in Pakistan benefit from increased demand, impacting local and regional markets.

n9734ceaa18.summary: India’s retail inflation is expected to hover around 4.8%, with food and beverage prices contributing to the trend.

nf3534d3902.summary: Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. reported a 39.4% decline in net profit in Q1 compared to last year.

n0043fc4947.summary: Australia's government anticipates a budget surplus, supported by high commodity prices and employment levels.

n99a26689fb.summary: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology reports four volcanic earthquakes at Mayon Volcano in the Bicol Region.

n55d7f4319e.headline: Tech job market in India booming, 66 pc demand in five core areas: Report

n55d7f4319e.why: India's expanding technology sector and digital economy drive strong hiring trends, impacting labor markets, wages, and tech company growth prospects.
